feature: Placeholder pembuatan work item di DataHive UEN/FIN (createWorkItemForPRSC, ForEPExpired, ForLTVPExpired, ForWPExpired)
note: Fungsi work item hanya menulis log placeholder untuk kasus FIN/work pass, tidak menyimpan apa pun. Mirip dengan work item di story OCMS41.61/OCMS41.62 yang Removed; tidak diklaim.
note_en: The work item functions only write a placeholder log for FIN/work pass cases and persist nothing. Similar to the work item in the Removed stories OCMS41.61/OCMS41.62; not claimed.

feature: TS-NRO otomatis untuk alamat MHA yang invalid (invalid tag, street NA, postal 000000, tanggal ubah alamat di masa depan)
note: Notice di-TS-NRO otomatis saat alamat dari MHA tidak valid. Ini suspend karena alamat bermasalah, mirip OCMS41.62 (Removed) tetapi pemicunya alamat invalid, bukan beda registered vs furnished; tidak diklaim di story ini.
note_en: The notice is automatically TS-NRO'd when the MHA address is invalid. This is a suspension caused by an address problem, similar to OCMS41.62 (Removed), but the trigger is an invalid address, not registered vs furnished; not claimed under this story.

feature: Aturan prioritas alamat surat: furnished_mail memegang letter_address=Y, mha_reg tidak menimpa; setelah Toppan flag pindah ke mha_reg > lta_reg > lta_mail
note: Code memutuskan alamat surat lewat flag letter_address, bukan lewat perbandingan registered vs furnished. Mirip keputusan 'alamat mana yang dipakai' di OCMS41.61/OCMS41.62 (Removed); tidak diklaim.
note_en: The code decides the letter address through the letter_address flag, not by comparing registered vs furnished. Similar to the 'which address to use' decision in OCMS41.61/OCMS41.62 (Removed); not claimed.
